**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (insert at preferred level).**

- **Investigation:** Searched the full document for "insurance", "insur", "coverage", "certificate", "workers compensation" and "liability". The only "insur" hit is "mortgage insurers" in the recitals (p0005); the liability hits are disclaimers/caps in Section 12 (p0077). I read the entire indemnity/general-provisions block (p0070–p0110), which covers indemnity, term, termination, assignment, notices, governing law, venue, fees, no-partnership and force majeure — no insurance obligation exists anywhere, and there is no Exhibit content (Exhibits A and B are TBD charge schedules).
- **Why it matters:** TrueLink hosts our Web Site and transmits Client and consumer credit data through the Interface, which is squarely the playbook's walk-away scenario (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data).
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0097 adding a new Section 31 carrying exactly the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where TrueLink processes data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. I deliberately omitted the model language's "at its own expense" and one-year survival tail as non-element boilerplate, and drew the Customer Data trigger broadly rather than naming a few data examples. The comment offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback.
